description: Blargg dmc_dma_during_read4 (5 ROMs), rebuilt on blargg's modern shell (instr_test-v5/source/common) with the suite's own DMC-sync code (common/sync_dmc.s, common/common.inc); patches/ make each ROM report its result over the $401E VELOCE-RESULT/1 port (tests/roms-src/include/veloce-blargg.inc). Upstream's shipped binaries use an older console+serial shell and never write the $6000 block (NES-3).
license: blargg (Shay Green) test code; upstream dmc_dma_during_read4/source/readme.txt carries no licence statement (plan section 8 treats blargg's NES test ROMs as freely usable). Only Veloce's patch is committed; sources are fetched at the pinned SHA.
golden_gate_reason: Rebuilt on purpose against a different shell than the one upstream's binary was built with (instr_test-v5/source/common, blargg's modern shell with text_out.s, instead of this suite's own older console+serial common/), so the result cannot be byte-identical by construction. For the record, the unmodified source built against its OWN common/ with the same toolchain is the same size as upstream's shipped ROM but not byte-identical either (1242-1250 bytes differ per ROM, first divergence at file offset 0x6072-0x6472) -- the same '--feature force_range' situation tests/roms-src/nes/cpu_dummy_reads/PROVENANCE.md documents. Verified behaviourally instead; see PROVENANCE.md.

commands: ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o dma_2007_read.o dma_2007_read.s
ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o dma_2007_write.o dma_2007_write.s
ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o dma_4016_read.o dma_4016_read.s
ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o double_2007_read.o double_2007_read.s
ca65 --feature force_range --smart -t nes -I vcommon -I /veloce-include -I /opt/rom-toolchain/cc65-asminc -o read_write_2007.o read_write_2007.s
